name: analyze-tensegrity-system
description: Analyze a tensegrity system by identifying compression struts and tension cables, classifying type (class 1/2, biological/architectural), computing prestress equilibrium, verifying stability via Maxwell's rigidity criterion, and mapping biological tensegrity (microtubules, actin, intermediate filaments). Use when evaluating tensegrity in architecture, robotics, cell biology, or any system with isolated compression in continuous tension.
